kafka_broker: Apache Kafka 4.2.2 (KRaft, single node, host process; release tarball SHA-512 verified)
notes: Shared developer machine: the VS Code renderer and its Java and C++ language servers each used about one core throughout; routes rotate order every run so that load widens spreads rather than biasing one route.
